title: Malai Kulfi
subtitle: Slow-reduced milk, cardamom and saffron
respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
intro: The matka kulfi of every summer evening, reduced the patient way in a kadhai and finished with Milkmaid. The CREAMi turns the dense, caramel-edged milk into a spoonable scoop that still tastes of the kulfi-wala's cart.

ingredients.note: or any 6% milk; reduced to 240 ml

steps.text: Simmer the milk in a wide, heavy kadhai on medium-low for about 25 min, stirring and scraping the sides in, until reduced to 240 ml.
Stir in the Milkmaid, cardamom, saffron and khoya, if using. Simmer 2–3 min, then take off the heat.
Cool to room temperature, about 45 min, or 15 min over an ice-water bath. Never put a warm base in the Blast.
Blend the cooled base and cream in the Ninja Blast for 20–30 s; any longer and the cream starts to whip.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the pistachios and almonds, and run MIX-IN.
Scoop at once, or rest 5 min for a denser, more kulfi-like bite.

tips: Use your widest heavy pan; more surface means faster reduction and fewer scorched spots.
Measure the cooled reduction. Over 250 ml and the base will pass MAX FILL once the cream goes in; drink the extra.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again. The nuts soften a little.
swaps: Protein: reduce toned milk, use 50 g Milkmaid, swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Kesar pista: double the saffron, bloomed in 1 tbsp warm milk, and use 20 g pistachios as the only mix-in.
Rabri kulfi: add the 30 g khoya and 1 tbsp milk powder to the reduction for a grainier texture.
shop_note: Khoya: local mithai shop or Amul khoya on BigBasket. Saffron: Baby Brand or Lion on Blinkit or Zepto.

gym.why: Toned milk is still reduced for the caramel kulfi taste; milk powder and cornflour replace khoya and cream, High Protein Milk adds 28 g protein. Fat lands near 17 g, from milk and pistachios.

replace.note: or any toned milk; reduced to 200 ml
or any allulose; add off the heat

replace.text: Simmer the toned milk in a wide, heavy kadhai on medium-low for about 20 min, stirring and scraping the sides in, until reduced to 200 ml.
Whisk the milk powder and cornflour into 60 ml of the High Protein Milk, stir into the pan with cardamom and saffron, and simmer 2 min.
Off the heat, cool below 70 °C and stir in the Munkito. Cool fully, about 45 min, or over an ice-water bath.
Blend the cooled base with the remaining High Protein Milk in the Ninja Blast for 30 s. Rest 2 min so the foam settles.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the pistachios and run MIX-IN.

diabetic.why: Reduced toned milk keeps the kulfi flavour; smooth-blended paneer and milk powder replace cream and khoya, cooked cornflour keeps it creamy without gum, Munkito replaces Milkmaid. Fat halves, protein nearly doubles.

replace.note: or any toned milk; reduced to 300 ml
or any allulose; add off the heat

replace.text: Simmer the toned milk in a wide, heavy kadhai on medium-low for about 25 min, stirring and scraping the sides in, until reduced to 300 ml.
Whisk the milk powder and cornflour with 3 tbsp of the hot milk, stir back in with cardamom and saffron, and simmer 2 min until lightly thick.
Off the heat, cool below 70 °C and stir in the Munkito. Cool fully, about 45 min, or over an ice-water bath.
Blend the cooled base and paneer in the Ninja Blast for 45–60 s, until completely smooth with no grain left.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.

gum_option.note: blend in at BLAST; smoother, fewer re-spins

title: Alphonso Aamras Ice Cream
subtitle: Ratnagiri mango pulp, cream and cardamom
respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
intro: Aamras-puri lunches in May are the reason this pint exists. A tin of Alphonso or Kesar pulp makes it possible in December too, and cream rounds the fruit's tang into mango-kulfi territory.

ingredients.item: Alphonso or Kesar mango pulp, sweetened
ingredients.note: Swad tin; fresh pulp needs 1 tbsp sugar

steps.text: Chill the mango pulp and cream for a few hours so the base starts cold.
Blend the pulp, Milkmaid, milk, cardamom and salt in the Ninja Blast for 20 s. Add the cream; blend 15 s more.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
If the top has a hump, let the pint sit 5 min. Run ICE CREAM.
If the edges look powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once.
Top with fresh mango cubes in season.

tips: Taste the pulp first. Tinned Kesar is usually sweeter than Alphonso; unsweetened Harvesta pulp needs 2 extra tbsp sugar.
Fresh mangoes must be fully ripe and fibre-free. Stringy Totapuri makes a grainy, sour pint.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Protein: replace cream and milk with 180 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM (adds about 33 g protein).
Kesar-elaichi: bloom 10 saffron strands in 1 tbsp warm milk, cool, and add with the cardamom.
Mango lassi: cut the cream to 100 ml and replace the milk with 100 g thick curd for a gentle tang.
shop_note: Mango pulp: Swad Alphonso or Kesar, or Harvesta (unsweetened), on Blinkit, Zepto and Amazon.

gym.why: Fresh mango replaces sweetened pulp; skyr, High Protein Milk and milk powder replace cream and Milkmaid. Mango pulp and skyr give thick body, Munkito keeps it scoopable, xanthan stops iciness.

replace.text: Chill the mango and skyr for a few hours so the base starts cold.
Blend everything in the Ninja Blast for 40–60 s until silky. Rest 2 min so the foam settles.
If the top has a hump, let the pint sit 5 min. Run LITE ICE CREAM.

diabetic.why: 100 g ripe fresh mango gives the flavour without tinned sugar; plain skyr, whey isolate and milk powder replace cream and Milkmaid for a thick, creamy body. Munkito sweetens and softens.

replace.note: fresh; the most fragrant you can find

replace.text: Chill the mango, skyr and milk for a few hours so the base starts cold.
Blend everything in the Ninja Blast for 40–60 s until silky. Rest 2–3 min so the whey foam settles before pouring.
If the top has a hump, let the pint sit 5 min. Run LITE ICE CREAM.
Serve at once; a few fresh mango cubes on top are plenty.

gum_option.note: blend in at BLAST; smoother, fewer re-spins

title: Filter Coffee Ice Cream
subtitle: Chicory decoction with kaapi sweetness
respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
intro: A tumbler of Chennai degree kaapi, frozen. A thick chicory-blend decoction gives the bitter, toasty edge instant coffee never quite manages, and Milkmaid brings back the sweetness of a darshini counter.

ingredients.note: Cothas, Narasu's, Leo or Bru Green Label
1 tsp more for very sweet kaapi

steps.text: Tamp the coffee lightly into the top of a South Indian filter, pour in the boiling water and leave 12–15 min to drip.
Collect about 60 ml decoction and cool to room temperature, about 15 min. Never put hot decoction in the Blast.
Blend the decoction, milk, Milkmaid and sugar in the Ninja Blast for 20 s. Add the cream; blend 15 s more.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Serve in a steel davara-tumbler, dusted with coffee powder.

tips: No filter? Steep the powder in the boiling water for 10 min, then strain through a paper filter or muslin.
Use only the first, thick drip; a second pour of water makes a watery, icy pint.
Instant shortcut: dissolve 2 tsp Bru Instant in 3 tbsp hot water, cool, and use instead of decoction.
swaps: Protein: swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey, sugar for 3 spoons Sugar Free Natura; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Jaggery kaapi: replace the sugar with 15 g jaggery powder dissolved in the warm decoction.
Mocha kaapi: blend 1 tbsp cocoa in with the milk.

egg_option.title: Kaapi custard with 2 yolks
egg_option.text: Adds a cook step. Heat the milk and sugar until steaming, slowly whisk into 2 yolks, then stir on low heat to 80–82 °C until it coats a spoon. Cut milk to 150 ml. Add decoction and Milkmaid; cool fully.

shop_note: Filter coffee: Cothas, Narasu's or Bru Green Label on Amazon, BigBasket, Instamart. Steel filter: Amazon or any utensil shop.

gym.why: Same strong decoction; High Protein Milk and milk powder replace cream and Milkmaid, Munkito replaces sugar. Milk powder and xanthan give the body cream used to, allulose keeps it soft.

replace.text: Blend the decoction, both milks, milk powder, Munkito and xanthan in the Ninja Blast for 30–40 s. Rest 2 min so the foam settles.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.

diabetic.why: Same kaapi decoction; toned milk, whey isolate and milk powder replace cream and Milkmaid, Munkito replaces sugar. Cornflour cooked into part of the milk gives creaminess without gum.

replace.note: or any allulose; add off the heat

replace.text: Collect about 60 ml decoction. Cool it and the thickened milk to room temperature, about 20 min. Never put a hot base in the Blast.
Blend the decoction, thickened milk, remaining milk, whey and milk powder in the Ninja Blast for 30 s. Rest 2–3 min so the foam settles.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.

insert.text: Meanwhile, whisk the cornflour into 150 ml of the milk and simmer 2 min, stirring, until thick. Off the heat, stir in the Munkito.

gum_option.note: blend in at BLAST; smoother, fewer re-spins

title: Meetha Paan Ice Cream
subtitle: Fresh betel, gulkand and tutti-frutti
respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
intro: Everything a paanwala folds into a meetha paan goes into this pint: cool betel leaf, gulkand, fennel and jewel-bright tutti-frutti. Fresh leaves give pale green flecks and a peppery perfume no paan essence can copy.

ingredients.item: fresh paan (betel) leaves, Calcutta or Maghai

steps.text: Wash and dry the paan leaves. Cut out the stems and thick central vein, which taste bitter, and tear the leaves.
Blend the leaves, milk, gulkand, saunf and Milkmaid in the Ninja Blast for 45–60 s, until the leaves are fine specks.
Add the cream; blend 15 s more. For a smoother pint, strain through a tea strainer.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the tutti-frutti and coated saunf, and run MIX-IN.
Drizzle with a little gulkand and top with a sliver of paan leaf.

tips: Stick to 4 leaves. More turns the pint grassy and bitter; fewer leave only a faint perfume.
Calcutta (Bangla) leaves are sharper and more peppery; Maghai and Banarasi are milder. Ask your paanwala for fresh, unblemished leaves.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin. Add coated saunf only on the first serve; it bleeds colour once frozen.
swaps: Protein: swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey and halve the Milkmaid; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Chocolate paan: swap the tutti-frutti for 25 g chopped Amul dark chocolate.
Banarasi style: blend in 4 cardamom pods and 1 tsp desiccated coconut.
shop_note: Paan leaves: local paan shop, or betel leaves for puja on Blinkit/Zepto. Gulkand, tutti-frutti: Blinkit, BigBasket, Amazon.

gym.why: Gulkand cut to 2 tsp with rose water for perfume; High Protein Milk and milk powder replace cream and Milkmaid. Pistachios and roasted saunf replace tutti-frutti. About 9 g added sugar, all from gulkand.

replace.note: Dabur; less, boosted with rose water

replace.text: Blend the leaves, both milks, gulkand, saunf, rose water, milk powder and Munkito in the Ninja Blast for 45–60 s, until the leaves are fine specks.
Rest 2 min so the foam settles. For a smoother pint, strain through a tea strainer.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the pistachios and roasted saunf, and run MIX-IN.
Top with a sliver of paan leaf and a pinch of roasted saunf.

diabetic.why: Paan leaves, saunf, rose water and dried rose petals carry the flavour without gulkand; smooth-blended paneer and milk powder replace cream and Milkmaid. Pistachios and roasted saunf replace tutti-frutti.

replace.text: Blend the leaves, milk, rose petals, saunf, rose water, milk powder and Munkito in the Ninja Blast for 45–60 s, until the leaves are fine specks.
Add the paneer; blend 45 s more, until silky with no grain. For a smoother pint, strain through a tea strainer.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the pistachios and roasted saunf, and run MIX-IN.
Top with a sliver of paan leaf and a few rose petals.

gum_option.note: blend in at BLAST; smoother, fewer re-spins

title: Gulab Jamun Ice Cream
subtitle: Rose-cardamom cream with jamun chunks
respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
intro: Hot gulab jamun with vanilla ice cream is a wedding buffet staple; this pint folds the two into one scoop. A rose-cardamom base, sweetened partly with jamun syrup, carries chewy pieces of tinned jamun.

ingredients.item: gulab jamun syrup, from the tin

mixins.item: tinned gulab jamun, in 1 cm pieces

steps.text: Lift 2 jamuns from the tin, gently squeeze out the syrup and chop into 1 cm pieces. Chill, covered.
Blend the milk, Milkmaid, jamun syrup, cardamom and rose water in the Ninja Blast for 20 s. Add the cream; blend 15 s more.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Freeze the jamun pieces for 20–30 min first. Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add jamun and pistachios, and run MIX-IN.
Scoop at once, beside one warm gulab jamun for the buffet effect.

tips: Firm the jamun pieces in the freezer first. Straight from the tin, the blade smears them into the base.
Rose waters vary in strength. Start with ½ tsp; too much tastes of soap, not mithai.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin. The jamun pieces stay chewy after a second freeze.
swaps: Protein: swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey, keeping the jamun mix-in; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Kala jamun or rasgulla: use the same amount of chopped kala jamun, or squeezed rasgulla with its syrup.
Kesar jamun: bloom 10 saffron strands in 1 tbsp warm milk; cool and add with the rose water.
shop_note: Tinned gulab jamun: Haldiram's or Bikano on Blinkit, Zepto, BigBasket. Edible rose water: Puramio or Mr. Merchant on Blinkit.

gym.why: Rose-cardamom base on High Protein Milk and milk powder, sweetened with Munkito; the syrup goes and one rinsed jamun gives the mix-in, about 7 g added sugar. Milk powder brings the creamy body.

replace.item: tinned gulab jamun, rinsed, in 1 cm pieces

replace.text: Lift 1 jamun from the tin, rinse under warm water, gently squeeze and chop into 1 cm pieces. Chill, covered.
Blend both milks, milk powder, Munkito, cardamom and rose water in the Ninja Blast for 30 s. Rest 2 min so the foam settles.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Scoop at once, with a pinch of chopped pistachio on top.

diabetic.why: Gulab jamun is fried khoya soaked in sugar syrup; without it there is no dish. The Diabetic Malai Kulfi gives the same cardamom-milk comfort.

title: Sitaphal Ice Cream
subtitle: Custard apple, Naturals-style, barely sweetened
respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
intro: Naturals made sitaphal the flavour people queue for, and the secret is real fruit with very little else. Custard apple is already creamy and honey-sweet, so it needs only cream, milk and a spoon of Milkmaid.

steps.text: Split the fruit, scoop out the segments and pick out every seed by hand; one crushed seed makes the pint bitter. Discard core and skin.
Blend the pulp, milk and Milkmaid in the Ninja Blast for 20 s. Add the cream; blend 10–15 s until just smooth.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Serve plain; sitaphal is delicate, so skip strong toppings.

tips: Season runs roughly September to December. Off-season, thaw Fooda frozen custard apple pulp in the fridge overnight.
Use only fully ripe fruit that gives when pressed; underripe sitaphal tastes starchy and flat frozen.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Protein: swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey and cut Milkmaid to 25 g; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Ramphal or chikoo: use the same weight of ripe, deseeded ramphal or peeled chikoo pulp.
Sitaphal rabri: blend in 30 g crumbled khoya and cut the milk to 50 ml.
shop_note: Fresh sitaphal: Blinkit, Zepto, BigBasket in season. Frozen pulp: Fooda Custard Apple on BigBasket.

gym.why: Sitaphal's own sugar does most of the sweetening; smooth-blended paneer and High Protein Milk replace cream and Milkmaid, like a sitaphal basundi. The fruit's pectin and paneer keep it creamy.

replace.text: Blend the pulp, paneer, milk and Munkito in the Ninja Blast for 45–60 s, until the paneer is completely smooth.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.

diabetic.why: Fruit drops to 100 g; smooth-blended paneer, toned milk and milk powder replace cream and Milkmaid, Munkito sweetens. Paneer and the fruit's pectin give a creamy body with half the fat.

replace.note: 1–2 ripe fruit, or unsweetened frozen pulp

replace.text: Blend the pulp, paneer, milk, milk powder and Munkito in the Ninja Blast for 45–60 s, until completely smooth.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.

gum_option.note: blend in at BLAST; smoother, fewer re-spins

title: Tender Coconut Ice Cream
subtitle: Soft malai, coconut water, chewy bits
respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
intro: Naturals' tender coconut converts people who think they dislike coconut. Two malai-wale nariyal give soft, jelly-like flesh and sweet water; most of the malai goes into the base, the rest in chewy pieces.

ingredients.note: coconut water is only lightly sweet

mixins.item: tender coconut malai, in 1 cm pieces, chilled

steps.text: Measure 100 ml coconut water. Scoop out the malai, scrape off any brown skin, and set 50 g aside for the mix-in.
Blend 100 g malai with the coconut water, Milkmaid, milk and sugar in the Ninja Blast for 30–40 s until smooth. Add cream; blend 10 s.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the chilled malai pieces and run MIX-IN.
Serve at once, while the malai pieces are soft and chewy.

tips: Ask for a 'malai wala' coconut with thin, soft flesh. Thick, mature malai blends grainy and tastes oily.
Keep mix-in pieces small. Big chunks of malai turn icy when refrozen.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Protein: swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey and skip the sugar; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Vegan: use thick coconut cream for the dairy cream, coconut milk for the milk, and 50 g sugar instead of Milkmaid.
Coconut-jaggery: replace the sugar and Milkmaid with 60 g jaggery powder dissolved in the coconut water.
shop_note: Tender coconuts: local nariyal-wala or Blinkit/Zepto. Packaged coconut water: Paper Boat or Raw Pressery on Blinkit, Amazon.

gym.why: Malai and coconut water stay; High Protein Milk and milk powder replace cream, Milkmaid and full cream milk, Munkito replaces the sugar. Blended malai and milk powder keep the body soft.

replace.text: Blend 100 g malai with the coconut water, milk, milk powder and Munkito in the Ninja Blast for 30–40 s until smooth. Rest 2 min.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.

diabetic.why: Malai and coconut water carry the flavour; toned milk, whey isolate and milk powder replace cream, Milkmaid and sugar. Blended malai gives natural creaminess, Munkito keeps it scoopable without gum.

replace.text: Blend 100 g malai with the coconut water, milk, whey, milk powder and Munkito in the Ninja Blast for 30–40 s. Rest 2–3 min so the foam settles.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.

gum_option.note: blend in at BLAST; smoother, fewer re-spins

title: Masala Chai Ice Cream
subtitle: Kadak doodh-patti chai with Parle-G
respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
intro: Strong, spiced chai with a Parle-G dunked in it is India's real comfort food. Brewing the tea in full cream milk keeps it bold enough to survive freezing, and the biscuit softens just as it does in the cup.

ingredients.note: Tata Tea Gold, Red Label or Wagh Bakri

ingredients.item: 4 green cardamom pods, 2 cloves, 2 cm cinnamon, 4 peppercorns, crushed

steps.text: Boil the milk with the crushed spices and saunth. Add the tea and simmer on low for 6–8 min, until deep tan.
Strain, pressing the leaves; you want about 250 ml. Stir in the Milkmaid and sugar while hot.
Cool to room temperature, about 40 min, or over an ice-water bath. Never pour hot chai into the Blast.
Blend the cooled chai and cream in the Ninja Blast for 15–20 s.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the Parle-G pieces and run MIX-IN.
Serve in a kulhad with a pinch of cinnamon on top.

tips: Fresh ginger can curdle hot milk; saunth gives the same warmth with no risk.
Brew stronger than you would drink. Cold dulls spice and tannin, so chai that tastes too kadak hot is right frozen.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin. The biscuit softens more on day two, which many prefer.
swaps: Protein: use toned milk and Sugar Free Natura; swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Elaichi chai: skip the other spices and use 8 crushed cardamom pods.
Chai-rusk: swap the Parle-G for 2 broken Britannia Toastea rusks.

egg_option.title: Chai custard with 2 yolks
egg_option.text: Whisk 2 yolks in a bowl; slowly whisk in the hot sweetened chai, then stir on low heat to 80–82 °C until it coats a spoon. Cut cream to 90 ml. Cool fully; Blast.

shop_note: Saunth and tea masala: Everest or MDH at any kirana or Blinkit. Kulhads: Amazon.

gym.why: Chai brewed in toned milk, thickened with milk powder; High Protein Milk replaces cream, Munkito replaces Milkmaid and sugar. Three Parle-G keep the crunch at about 3 g added sugar.

replace.text: Strain, pressing the leaves; you want about 250 ml. Whisk in the milk powder while hot.
Cool below 70 °C and stir in the Munkito, then cool fully, about 40 min, or over an ice-water bath. Never pour hot chai into the Blast.
Blend the cooled chai and High Protein Milk in the Ninja Blast for 20–30 s. Rest 2 min so the foam settles.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.

diabetic.why: More toned milk brewed into chai, thickened with milk powder and cooked cornflour instead of cream; whey adds body, Munkito replaces Milkmaid and sugar. Toasted almonds replace Parle-G for crunch.

replace.text: Strain, pressing the leaves; you want about 370 ml. Whisk in the milk powder and cornflour slaked in 2 tbsp cold milk; simmer 2 min.
Cool below 70 °C and stir in the Munkito, then cool fully, about 40 min, or over an ice-water bath. Never pour hot chai into the Blast.
Blend the cooled chai and whey in the Ninja Blast for 20–30 s. Rest 2–3 min so the foam settles.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the toasted almonds and run MIX-IN.

title: Kesar Badam Doodh Ice Cream
subtitle: Mumbai's kesar badam milk, frozen
respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
intro: The chilled glass bottle of kesar badam doodh from the corner dairy, turned into a scoop. Soaked, peeled almonds blended into saffron milk give the body, so it needs only a splash of cream.

ingredients.note: overnight, or 30 min in hot water

steps.text: Soak the almonds overnight, or 30 min in just-boiled water. Pinch off the skins; they should slip right off.
Heat 100 ml of the milk until steaming. Off the heat, add the saffron and cardamom and steep 15 min until deep gold.
Cool the saffron milk to room temperature, about 10 min. Never put warm milk in the sealed Blast.
Blend the almonds with the saffron milk in the Ninja Blast for 60 s until silky. Add the remaining milk, Milkmaid and cream; blend 20 s.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
If the top has a hump, let the pint sit 5 min. Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the slivered almonds, and run MIX-IN.
Scoop into chilled glasses and finish with a few saffron strands.

tips: Blend the almonds with only the saffron milk first. Less liquid means a finer paste and no gritty bits.
Saffron colour deepens overnight in the freezer, so don't add more strands if the base looks pale.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Badam pista: replace half the almonds with soaked pistachios and use pistachios as the mix-in.
Rose badam: add 1 tsp Dabur Gulabari rose water with the Milkmaid.
Richer: add 20 g crumbled khoya to the warm saffron milk for a rabri-like depth.
shop_note: Saffron: Baby Brand or Lion on Blinkit or Zepto. Almonds: California or Mamra on BigBasket or any kirana.

gym.why: Amul High Protein Milk and milk powder replace Gold milk and cream; Munkito replaces Milkmaid. Allulose keeps it soft, and the almond paste plus milk powder give the body cream used to.

replace.note: overnight, or 30 min in hot water

add.item: Amul Slim n Trim skimmed milk

replace.text: Blend the almonds with the saffron milk for 60 s until silky. Add both remaining milks, Munkito and milk powder; blend 20 s.
If the top has a hump, let the pint sit 5 min. Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.

diabetic.why: Toned milk and milk powder replace Gold milk and cream; Munkito replaces Milkmaid. Almond paste and milk solids keep it creamy, allulose keeps it scoopable, and fat drops by more than half.

replace.note: overnight, or 30 min in hot water

replace.text: Blend the almonds with the saffron milk for 60 s until silky. Add the remaining milk, Munkito and milk powder; blend 20 s.
If the top has a hump, let the pint sit 5 min. Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.

title: Gajar Halwa Ice Cream
subtitle: Winter halwa, frozen into a scoop
respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
intro: December's red Delhi carrots, slow-cooked in milk with khoya and elaichi, then blended into a pint. A spoonful of unblended halwa goes back in at the end, so every scoop has proper chunks.

steps.text: Sauté the carrots in the ghee in a heavy kadhai on medium for 5 min, until they darken slightly and smell sweet.
Add 200 ml of the milk; simmer, stirring, 20–25 min until almost dry. Stir in the sugar, khoya and cardamom; cook 3 min.
Spoon out 2 tbsp halwa for the mix-in and chill it. Cool the rest to room temperature, about 30 min.
Blend the cooled halwa with the remaining 130 ml cold milk and the cream in the Ninja Blast for 45–60 s until smooth.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
If the top has a hump, let the pint sit 5 min. Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the cashews, raisins and reserved halwa, and run MIX-IN.
Serve slightly soft, with extra toasted cashews on top.

tips: Grate fine. Coarse shreds stay stringy in the Blast and freeze into icy threads.
Cook until the milk is almost gone; leftover liquid makes the pint icy, not creamy.
Measure the base after blending. Over 450 ml and it passes MAX FILL; drink the extra.
swaps: Leftover halwa: blend 250 g ready gajar halwa with 130 ml milk and the cream; skip the cooking.
Kesar gajar: add 10 saffron strands with the cardamom.
Nutty: swap cashews for chopped almonds and pistachios.
shop_note: Red Delhi carrots: November to February at any sabziwala, Blinkit or BigBasket. Khoya: Amul on BigBasket or a mithai shop.

gym.why: No ghee, skimmed milk, high-protein paneer instead of khoya, milk powder instead of cream, Munkito instead of sugar. Blended paneer and milk solids give body; allulose keeps it soft.

title: Kesar Phirni Ice Cream
subtitle: Rice-flour kheer, Eid-table creamy
respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
intro: Phirni set in clay shikoras is the dessert of every Eid table. Coarse rice flour thickens the milk so well that this pint needs no cream or gum, just saffron, rosewater and pistachios.

steps.text: Whisk the rice flour into 100 ml of the cold milk until lump-free. Bloom the saffron in 1 tbsp warm milk.
Boil the remaining milk in a heavy pan. Whisk in the rice slurry; cook on low 8–10 min, stirring constantly, until it coats a spoon thickly.
Stir in the sugar, saffron and cardamom; cook 2 min more. Off the heat, stir in the rose water.
Press cling film onto the surface and cool to room temperature, about 45 min. It sets like soft custard.
Blend the cooled phirni in the Ninja Blast for 30 s to loosen it into a smooth, pourable base.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run GELATO. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the pistachios, and run MIX-IN. Serve with a few rose petals.

tips: Stir the whole time the rice cooks. It catches on the bottom within a minute and the scorched taste spreads.
Fine rice flour turns gluey; coarse gives the classic phirni grain. Rava-textured flour from a chakki is ideal.
Rose water is strong. Start with 1 tsp; you can add more in the Blast, never take it out.
swaps: Shahi: add 20 g crumbled khoya with the sugar and use almonds plus pistachios as mix-ins.
Mango phirni: replace 100 ml milk with 100 g Alphonso pulp, blended in after cooling; cut sugar to 45 g.
Kewra: use 2 drops kewra essence instead of the rose water.
shop_note: Coarse rice flour: chakki or kirana, or grind soaked basmati. Rose water: Dabur Gulabari on Blinkit, Zepto or Amazon.in.

gym.why: Amul High Protein Milk, skimmed milk and a little milk powder replace Gold milk; Munkito replaces sugar. The rice starch still gives the gelato body, and allulose keeps it soft.

title: Mysore Pak Ice Cream
subtitle: Ghee-roasted besan, melt-in-mouth
respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
intro: Bengaluru's soft, ghee-heavy Mysore pak, melted into ice cream. Besan roasted slowly in ghee until it smells of biscuits gets cooked into the milk, and crumbled Mysore pak goes in at the end.

steps.text: Melt the ghee in a heavy kadhai on low. Add the besan; roast, stirring constantly, 8–10 min until golden, nutty and loose like wet sand.
Take off the heat. Whisk in the warm milk a splash at a time, so no lumps form, then return to medium heat.
Add the sugar and simmer, whisking, 4–5 min until it thickens like thin custard. Stir in the salt and cardamom.
Cool to room temperature, about 40 min, whisking once or twice. Never put a warm base in the Blast.
Blend the cooled base with the cream in the Ninja Blast for 20–30 s until smooth; any longer and the cream starts to whip.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
If the top has a hump, let the pint sit 5 min. Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the crumbled Mysore pak, and run MIX-IN.

tips: Roast on low and never stop stirring. Raw besan tastes bitter and grassy; burnt besan can't be rescued.
Warm milk stops the ghee from seizing. Cold milk on hot besan gives lumps the Blast can't fully fix.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin. The Mysore pak bits soften but stay tasty.
swaps: No Mysore pak at hand: roast 2 extra tbsp besan in 1 tsp ghee until crumbly, cool, and use as the mix-in.
Badam pak: swap 10 g besan for almond flour and add slivered almonds as the mix-in.
Kesar: bloom 10 saffron strands in the warm milk before whisking it in.
shop_note: Mysore pak: Sri Krishna Sweets, Anand or any sweet shop; also on Swiggy Instamart. Besan: any kirana.

gym.why: Ghee cut to 1½ tsp, skimmed milk, milk powder and unflavoured whey instead of Gold milk and cream, Munkito instead of sugar. Cooked besan and milk solids give body; allulose keeps it soft.
